nougatModelKwargs.description:
Nougat model kwargs.
See {@link https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/nougat} for more keyword arguments.

nougatMaxBatchSize.description: The maximum batch size for nougat. The default is 64 which is approx 385MB w/ 640x400 sized RGB images.

nougatStoppingCriteriaThreshold.description: The threshold used in nougat stopping criteria.

nougatStoppingCriteriaWindowSize.description: The window size used in nougat stopping criteria.
